answer: Post a small daily batch of tiny bounties, like tagging photos of one ocean inlet, and let each key secretly claim one; if two keys pick the same bounty, both get nothing. Strangers collide at a natural, predictable rate. A sybil farm wants every key paid, so it steers its keys onto distinct bounties, and their mutual collision rate stays a crystal-clear zero far too often. Keys that never collide with each other across weeks are grouped and share one payout.
